scope.method: Individual static complete-tree semantic review. Every listed tracked file was read in full as inert source data. No bundled commands/scripts were executed.
scope.excluded: All unassigned skill trees; generated registry/plugin mirrors; merge, release and runtime/service certification.

reviewer: GPT-6.1 Sol; low reasoning; delegated campaign batch08
limitations: Review is bounded to the exact listed base/final file bytes. It is not whole-catalog certification, formal verification, runtime validation, a license/legal certification or a Tessl review.
Existing upstream authorship and license declarations were preserved; source attribution is not upstream endorsement. No missing helpers were invented or imported.
Third-party SDK examples and service operations were not compiled or run. Compatibility, billing, quotas, security and clinical outcomes require environment-specific verification.
Automated skill-review remains pending the PR workflow; merge requires truthful Tessl result or exact-full-head maintainer attestation.

validation.status: Pending final committed-head checks; results will be recorded in PR and external campaign receipt.
